Looking at the xplan-box architecture, the XPlanWMS workspace has a raster layer store that fetches raster data from MapServer. MapServer is a separate WMS, and in xplan-box it's typically deployed on the same Tomcat (port 8080) under the /xplan-mapserver context, or it's a separate CGI.
